page.overview:
Who is Ant with Seed?

The Ant with Seed is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"When a leaf breaks the line to the offering stone, a seed-carrier ant panics. "I'm lost!" he cries. Luckily Mr. Soil is there to lead the ants around the leaf and back to the line. "This is nothing compared to the twig of '93," he says."

The Ant with Seed is in a line, carrying a seed to the offering stone. A leaf falls in front of the Ant with Seed, causing him and the ants in line behind him to get seperated from the rest of the line. The Ant with Seed and some ants in line behind him panic. Mr. Soil comes and leads the Ant with Seed and the ants in line behind around the leaf. The Ant with Seed thanks Mr. Soil.
